title: How Tibo built 40 SEO mini tools for Tapo and Tweet Hunter, and why he bets on anti-AI positioning
summary: Tibo Louis-Lucas explains how a steady stream of free SEO mini tools drove most of Tapo and Tweet Hunter's traffic. He covers the Vidio-style pattern of tools that drop users straight into the main product, why tool searches should survive AI search, and why "no AI" positioning is an uncrowded arbitrage. He also pitches a brand-sponsorship page business built on moderation.

principles.text: Ship a steady stream of free SEO mini tools; together they became the majority of traffic.
principles.quote: we built more than one per month so at the end we had like 40 SE optimized mini tools

principles.text: Winners are unpredictable and low-intent keywords can still pay off: a quick LinkedIn video downloader out-ranked the researched tools.
principles.quote: it was a very low intent uh keyword for Tapo but super high traffic a million per month uh visitors super crazy

principles.text: Make each mini tool a feature of the main product so users land inside it with no signup.
principles.quote: they redirects to their main tool like vid doio and you are actually inside the tool without even signing up without paying for anything

principles.text: Action-based searches (find a tool to do X) will keep going to Google, so the mini-tool strategy holds up against AI search.
principles.quote: if you are looking for a tool uh to compress a video or to download a video from LinkedIn it's very unlikely to me that you're going to query that on tgbt because you are looking for a tool

principles.text: Anti-AI, human-made positioning is an under-crowded opening while AI niches are saturated.
principles.quote: the product itself is an anti- AI uh positioning because using this tool you are like certified to be a genuine human using a tool by hand

principles.text: In a seemingly saturated marketplace, the unsolved pain (sorting inbound applicants) is the product to build.
principles.quote: we got hundreds of application that it became a nightmare to sort them and to to spot the good ones so that's that's the real issue to solve
